name: Shadewell Spring has one Worldforged Shadewell Stabber pickup (COA-6829)
contract: The Worldforged Shadewell Stabber (item 824384) at Shadewell Spring, Elwynn Forest, is the Murloc Tool pickup (520066, guid 6900733). rev_20260930_99_ASC_northshire_revamp.sql added a second Murloc Tool (guid 7500149) at the same spot, and rev_20261014_95_worldforged_lootcollector_alignment.sql added a third pickup of the same item, Brambleblade Blade (9900025, guid 6970024), 10 yd away. Only the original remains: one Murloc Tool and no Brambleblade Blade near the spring.
